summary: Nine real kinds of fence with gates in gardens, farms and playgrounds, a security fence behind each HQ and mesh panels round the town's supply dump.
stage: game capture: --aivai --seed=3 --offscreen --nohud --perf=0 --shot-at=20 with --focus=-25,-3 --zoom=12 --pitch=-24 --cam-yaw=0.4 (street, before and after), --focus=6,503 --zoom=9 --pitch=-14 --cam-yaw=3.0 (HQ), --focus=-1,12 --zoom=10 --pitch=-26 --cam-yaw=2.6 (dump); tools/showcase/building-surfaces.tscn --building-components --building-kinds=fence_* (sheet); wire sheet: building-surfaces.tscn --building-components --building-kinds=wire_close,wire_barbed,fence_post_rail,fence_improvised,wire:0,wire:1; close-up: --building-kinds=wire_close --building-single (the wire drawn at four times life size)
rationale: Appearance change: a matched before/after of one street on the same seed and camera shows the town fences; single stills show the military fences, which are new; one studio sheet shows six fence kinds with their gates. Compatibility-renderer checks and other framings stay outside Git. A second studio sheet shows the three barbed wire finishes, both HQ perimeters and both sides' concertina.
